detailed_description:
The target video is a 15-second vertical short in Korean WEBTOON comic style with cinematic composition, cold desaturated office tones, and a bleak, oppressive realism.
[Shot 1] Cold white fluorescent light floods an open-plan office, quiet and oppressive, filled with young employees hunched over keyboards. A medium shot slowly pushes in on <Subject 1> Chen Kai at a corner desk, his face matching <Picture 1> exactly — black hair, stubble, exhausted numb expression, white shirt. On his desk sits a family photo; his phone screen lights up showing the mortgage auto-deduction success notification. A low, heavy piano score and oppressive ambient hum underlie the scene as a low male narrator voice (S1) speaks over the visuals, <d>[Chinese] 38岁这年，房贷刚刚扣完，公司就决定不要我了。</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to <Subject 2>, the HR staff member in cold professional attire standing at Chen Kai's desk, placing the layoff notice down. A close-up shows the paper landing on the desk with a slight camera shake; the paper-on-desk sound is amplified while the background audio ducks instantly. Chen Kai slowly raises his head, his eyes freezing. <Subject 2> (S2) says in a flat, cold female-or-neutral office voice, <d>[Chinese] 公司感谢你的贡献，但因为岗位优化，你被裁了。</d>
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, pale-faced Chen Kai rises from his chair and clenches his fist. The camera pans from him across to the glass-walled office, where <Subject 3> Zhou Ming stands with arms crossed, watching with a faint smile at the corner of his mouth. A heartbeat sound gradually grows louder. Chen Kai (S3) says in a strained male voice, <d>[Chinese] 是不是搞错了？我在这做了十二年。</d> <Subject 2> (S2) replies coldly without emotion, <d>[Chinese] 决定已经下来了。</d>
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, Chen Kai carries a cardboard box out of the building onto a street, where red and green traffic lights alternate across his face. His phone pops up the tutoring-class renewal reminder. The camera slowly pulls back, revealing fast-moving traffic and crowds streaming around him while he stands frozen and motionless, the shifting lights flickering over his face. Chen Kai (S3) murmurs in a low voice, <d>[Chinese] 公司淘汰的不是我……是年龄。</d> At the end, the hook text appears on screen character by character: “第2集：体面，被生活撕碎”.
